final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_ratio, s1.n, s1.avg_ratio * 1.0 / s2.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL
